function.name: shell_exec
function.description: Execute a command in PowerShell, CMD, Bash, or WSL on the local Windows computer and return stdout, stderr, exit code.

command.description: The command string to execute (e.g. 'dir', 'npm test', 'git status', 'python main.py').

cwd.description: Working directory to execute command in. Defaults to current workspace.

shell.description: Shell type to execute in. 'powershell' (PowerShell), 'cmd' (Windows CMD), 'bash' (Git Bash / Linux bash), 'wsl' (WSL2), or 'auto'.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before terminating the process (default 60s).

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file content from local disk. Supports text with line numbers/ranges or base64 binary encoding.

path.description: Path to file (absolute or relative to workspace).

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return (optional).

encoding.description: File encoding ('utf-8', 'gbk', 'binary'). If 'binary', returns base64 string.

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with given text or base64 binary content. Creates parent folders automatically.

path.description: Path to file (absolute or relative to workspace).

content.description: Text content to write to the file.

content_base64.description: Optional base64 binary data if writing binary file.

function.name: file_edit
function.description: Search and replace a specific text block within a file (exact or whitespace-tolerant match).

old_text.description: Text snippet to find and replace.

function.name: file_list
function.description: List files and directories inside a path with size, modified timestamp, and type.

show_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden files (starting with .).

function.name: file_tree
function.description: Generate a formatted visual tree structure of a directory with depth limit and ignored patterns.

function.name: file_search
function.description: Search for files by filename pattern (glob) or search file contents with regex grep.

content_regex.description: Regex pattern to grep file contents for.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: list_processes
function.description: List active system processes with PID, name, CPU %, memory usage, and command line.

name_filter.description: Optional filter string to match against process name or cmdline (e.g. 'node', 'python', 'chrome').

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return (sorted by memory usage).

function.name: kill_process
function.description: Terminate a running process by PID or process name.

name.description: Process name to terminate all matching instances (e.g. 'node.exe').

force.description: Whether to forcefully kill the process (SIGKILL / taskkill /F).

function.name: start_process
function.description: Start a persistent background process (e.g. dev server, npm run dev, python app.py) and return a job_id to monitor.

function.name: get_process_logs
function.description: Get status or active background jobs list.

job_id.description: Job ID (e.g. 'job-001'). Omit to list all background jobs.

function.name: list_open_ports
function.description: List all active TCP listening ports and the processes bound to them on the local computer.

function.name: proxy_http_request
function.description: Make an HTTP request from inside the local machine to a local dev server (e.g. http://localhost:3000/api) and return the response.

function.name: capture_screen
function.description: Capture the desktop screen, compress/downscale to save tokens, and return as base64 image for multimodal AI vision models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini).

max_width.description: Maximum width in pixels for downscaling (preserves aspect ratio, reduces AI token consumption). Set 0 for native resolution.

save_path.description: Optional file path to save the screenshot on disk (e.g. 'screenshot.jpg').

return_base64.description: Whether to return the base64 data URL in the response (default: True).

function.name: get_screen_info
function.description: Get information about display resolution, open application windows, and UI element positions.

function.name: show_popup
function.description: Display a native Windows popup dialog / message box on the user's screen.

message.description: Message text to display in the popup.

function.name: get_system_info
function.description: Retrieve comprehensive system hardware, OS version, CPU, RAM, disk space, and network info.

function.name: get_env_vars
function.description: Get system environment variables or query a specific environment variable.

key.description: Specific environment variable name to query (e.g. 'PATH', 'PYTHONPATH', 'USER'). Omit for all safe variables.

function.name: get_privilege_info
function.description: Check whether the local SHH agent currently runs with Windows Administrator (UAC elevated) rights, and which operations are available without a UAC prompt.

function.name: run_admin_command
function.description: Execute a shell command with Windows Administrator rights (e.g. netsh, sc, reg, mklink, driver/service management, writing to C:\Program Files, killing system processes). If SHH was started with start_shh_admin.bat it runs silently; otherwise ONE UAC prompt appears on the user's screen and must be approved.

command.description: Command line to execute with administrator privileges.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the command to finish.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the elevated command.

function.name: manage_firewall
function.description: Add / delete / list Windows Firewall inbound rules with administrator rights (allow a local port so other machines or tunnels can reach it).

name.description: Rule name (used for add/delete, and as the list filter keyword).

port.description: Local TCP port to allow (required for action=add).

function.name: manage_port_forward
function.description: Create / delete / list OS-level TCP port forwarding rules (netsh interface portproxy) so traffic arriving on a local port is forwarded to another local or LAN host:port. Requires Administrator.

connect_host.description: Target host to forward traffic to (IP or hostname).

listen_address.description: Local address to bind the listener to.

function.name: file_stat
function.description: Get metadata of a local file (size, mtime, sha256). Use it before/while transferring to plan chunk offsets and to RESUME an interrupted upload/download.

path.description: File path on the local computer.

hash.description: Also compute the full sha256 of the file (slower for big files).

function.name: file_upload_chunk
function.description: Upload ONE chunk of a file to an exact byte offset. Chunks keep request bodies small so the tunnel cannot be overloaded. Set offset=0 to start (or use truncate=true to overwrite); keep calling with the SAME file and increasing offsets to append. Returns next_offset so the transfer can resume precisely after a dropped tunnel.

path.description: Destination file path on the local computer.

offset.description: Byte offset where this chunk must be written (0 = start of file).

data_base64.description: Base64 of the chunk (use for binary files). Max ~256 KiB decoded per call.

data_text.description: Plain text chunk (utf-8). Use instead of data_base64 for text files.

compress.description: Set true if the payload is gzip-compressed (client should set this for text).

truncate.description: Truncate the destination file before writing (start of a new upload).

sha256_chunk.description: Optional sha256 of the DECODED chunk; verified server-side.

function.name: file_download_chunk
function.description: Read ONE chunk of a local file from an exact byte offset and return it base64-encoded (or as utf-8 text). Small chunks are what keep tunnel transfers stable; loop over offsets until eof=true. Optionally gzip-compress the chunk to cut tunnel traffic ~3-5x for text.

path.description: Source file path on the local computer.

max_bytes.description: Max raw bytes to return (clamped to the configured safe limit).

as_text.description: Return utf-8 text instead of base64 (only for text files).

compress.description: Gzip-compress the returned chunk (recommended for text/log files).

function.name: file_checksum
function.description: Compute the sha256 (and md5) checksum of a local file to verify a transfer completed intact.

path.description: File path on the local computer.

function.name: file_transfer_info
function.description: Explain the safe chunked-transfer strategy and the current hard size limits. Call this before moving big files so you never send an oversized packet that drops the tunnel.
